entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David, in his last words, professes his faith in God's promises to be beyond sense or experience. 6 The different state of the wicked. 8 A catalogue of David's mighty men.

A.M. 2989. B.C. 1015. An. Ex. Is. 476. the last. Ge 49:1; De 33:1; Jos 23:1-24:32; Ps 72:20; 2Pe 1:13-15 raised. 7:8,9; Ps 78:70 the anointed. 1Sa 2:10; 16:12,13; Ps 2:6; 89:20 sweet psalmist. 1Ch 16:4,5,7,9; Am 6:5; Lu 20:42; 24:44; Eph 5:19,20; Col 3:16 Jas 5:13

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: God. Ge 33:20; Ex 3:15; 19:5,6; 20:2 the Rock. 22:2,32; De 32:4,30,31; Ps 42:9 He that ruleth. or, Be thou ruler, etc. Ps 110:2 must be just. Ex 23:6-8; De 16:18-20; Ps 82:3,4; Pr 31:9; Isa 11:4,5; 32:1 Jer 23:5; Zec 9:9; Heb 1:8 ruling. Ex 18:21; 2Ch 19:7-9; Ne 5:14

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the sons. 20:1; De 13:13; 1Sa 2:12 thorns. Ge 3:18; So 2:2; Isa 33:12; Eze 2:6

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: fenced. Heb. filled. and they shall. 22:8-10; Isa 27:4; Mt 3:10-12; 13:42; Lu 19:14,27; Joh 15:6 2Th 1:8; 2:8; Heb 6:8

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
A.M. 2949-2989. B.C. 1055-1015. An. Ex. Is. 436-476. TheTachmonite. or, Josheb-bassebet, the Tachmonite, head of the three. 1Ch 11:11,12; 27:2,32 It is highly probable that in this version instead of {yoshaiv bashshaiveth tachkemoni,} we should read {yoshavam ben chachmoni,} "Joshebeam, son of Hachmoni;' and instead of {hoo adino ha�tzni, hoo �rair eth chanitho,} "he lift up his spear," which are the readings in the parallel place in Chronicles, where it is also, "three hundred," instead of "eight hundred."

whom he slew. Heb. slain.

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Shammah. 1Ch 11:27 Shammoth the Harorite. the Philistines. 1Ch 11:13,14 into a troop. or, for foraging.

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
three, etc. or, the three captains over the thirty. 1Ch 11:15-19 {Shalishim,} "captains," should most probably be read, instead of {shaloshim:} thirty {shalishim,} as it is in ver. 8, and Ex 14:7: where LXX. render [tristatas,] which Jerome (on Eze 33) says "among the Greeks is the name of the second rank after the royal dignity."

the cave. Jos 12:15; 15:35; 1Sa 22:1; Mic 1:15 the valley. 5:18,22; 1Ch 11:15; 14:9; Isa 17:5

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
longed. Nu 11:4,5; Ps 42:1,2; 63:1; 119:81; Isa 41:17; 44:3; Joh 4:10,14 Joh 7:37 Bethlehem.Bethlehem signifies the "house of bread," and the place was likewise noted for excellent water. There Christ was born, who is the "bread of life," and who also gives us the "water of life." "The water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life."

Joh 4:14

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the three. 9; 1Sa 19:5; Ac 20:24; Ro 5:7; 2Co 5:14 poured it. Nu 28:7; 1Sa 7:6; La 2:19; Php 2:17

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Benaiah. 8:18; 20:23; 1Ki 1:8,26,38; 2:29-35,46; 1Ch 18:17; 27:5,6 Kabzeel. Jos 15:21 who had done many acts. Heb. great of acts. he slew. Ex 15:15 lion-like men. Heb. lions of God. 1:23; 1Ch 11:22-24; 12:8 slew a lion. Jud 14:5,6; 1Sa 17:34-37

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:21
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a goodly man. Heb. a man of countenance, or sight. called. 1Ch 11:23 a man of great stature. slew him. 1Sa 17:51; Col 2:15

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:23
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: more honourable. or, honourable among the thirty. 1Ch 27:6 over his guard. or, over his council. Heb. at his command. 8:8; 20:23; 1Sa 22:14

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:30
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Benaiah. 1Ch 11:31; 27:14 Pirathonite. Jud 12:15 Hiddai. 1Ch 11:32 Hurai. brooks. or, valleys. De 1:24; Jud 2:9

entries.title: 2 Samuel 23:39
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Uriah. 11:3,6-27; 12:9; 1Ki 15:5; 1Ch 11:41; Mt 1:6 thirty and seven in all.From the number of these officers being thirty-seven, it is almost self-evident that {shalishim} cannot denote the thirty, as rendered in ver. 13, etc., but some particular description of men, or officers; for it can scarcely be said, with propriety, that we have thirty-seven out of thirty; and besides, in the parallel place in 1 Chronicles, there are sixteen added!
